global.name: yes
global.help: answer yes to confirmations (never implies --take-over, --replace-dns-record or --confirm-auth-change)

global.name: non-interactive
global.help: never prompt (also when CI is set or there is no terminal)

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Deploy or upgrade Backyard on your Cloudflare account (Workers free plan); re-running keeps every choice

flags.name: r2
flags.help: use an R2 bucket for big files (default when R2 is enabled)

flags.name: no-r2
flags.help: never use R2 (remembered)

flags.name: r2-bucket
flags.help: bucket name (default <worker>-files)

flags.name: var
flags.help: override a Worker variable (remembered; KEY: drops it)

flags.name: rotate-token
flags.help: issue a new DEPLOY_TOKEN

flags.name: rotate-secret
flags.help: replace BACKYARD_SECRET (revokes every API token)

flags.name: skip-deploy
flags.help: only (re)set secrets

flags.name: workers-subdomain
flags.help: workers.dev subdomain to register when the account has none

flags.name: workers-dev
flags.help: serve on workers.dev (default)

flags.name: no-workers-dev
flags.help: stop serving on workers.dev (needs a custom domain)

flags.name: confirm-auth-change
flags.help: allow a deploy that turns Cloudflare Access off or changes its team

flags.name: dry-run
flags.help: build and validate only (no login, no changes)

commands.name: domain add
commands.summary: Serve Backyard on your own domain (path mode), or sites on their own hosts (--host-mode)

flags.name: host-mode
flags.help: sites at https://<site>.<host>/ (wildcard route and DNS record)

flags.name: zone
flags.help: Cloudflare zone of <host> (default: found automatically)

flags.name: take-over
flags.help: move <host> or the *.<host>/* route from another Worker to this one

flags.name: replace-dns-record
flags.help: replace existing DNS records at <host>

flags.name: wait
flags.help: how long to wait for DNS, certificate and readiness (default 300)

commands.name: domain remove
commands.summary: Remove the custom domain this tool added: back to workers.dev

commands.name: access enable
commands.summary: Turn on company login with Cloudflare Access (needs a custom domain)

flags.name: allow-email
flags.help: allow this email

flags.name: allow-email-domain
flags.help: allow every email at this domain

flags.name: team
flags.help: Zero Trust team of existing Access applications

flags.name: aud
flags.help: AUD tag of the existing hub application

flags.name: wait
flags.help: how long to wait for Access (default 120; 900 while waiting for dashboard steps)

flags.name: delete-apps
flags.help: also delete the Access applications and policies this tool created (needs BACKYARD_CF_API_TOKEN)

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Read-only live check of the Worker, its domain and Cloudflare Access

flags.name: json
flags.help: machine-readable output
